Neither CBY-Sana’a nor CBY-Aden – nor, indeed, the commercial banks – operate through an electronically integrated system. Instead, they carry out payments independently and in complete isolation from one another.
Checks must be processed manually while SWIFT-based payment orders remain the primary avenue for large value payments.
